method: From Kalshi legs priced 30–85¢ with edge ≥ about −2.5 and no flags (one per game), a leg was kept only when at least two of these agreed and none disagreed: Polymarket's top sports traders on its side, a published expert pick or model read today, and concrete news/matchup reasoning. The dump's expert matching came back empty again, so experts were matched by hand against picks/latest.json. Only two legs (Raptors, Suns) had meaningful top-trader money; the rest rest on two or more outlets plus their reasoning. Colorado +10.5 sits at −2.73, slightly past the usual limit, kept because three outlets and the line move agree. Dropped as conflicts: Commanders/Giants (SI and BetMGM on New York, Covers and Sports Betting Dime on Washington, top traders on the Giants), Memphis/USF (four outlets on Memphis, top traders on USF and the line down 3 points), Pistons/Wizards spread (four outlets on Detroit, Covers, Dimers and top traders on Washington), Mavericks/Timberwolves (Covers and Dimers on Dallas, top traders on Minnesota), FSU/Pitt (VSiN and iHeart on FSU, Covers and Predictem on Pitt). Wild and Sabres moneylines and Louisiana's moneyline were priced worse than −3. No Friday NBA picks were published yet, so Friday is covered only by two college football legs.
honest: Every leg costs slightly more than fair, so expected return is slightly negative and gets worse with every leg added.

ladder.label: Toronto Raptors +10.5
ladder.why: Three outlets back Toronto and top traders have about $9.8k on it against $4.7k. Sports Mole notes Philadelphia's home margin is only +6.0 and three of its last four wins came by 6 or fewer; Predictem says the 76ers' 9-3 record hides a +1.0 net rating and projects 112-106. Caution: Scottie Barnes is out, Toronto is on a back-to-back, and Embiid and LeBron James are questionable.

ladder.label: Under 6.5
ladder.why: Three outlets take the under. Pickswise notes Boston allows 2.28 goals a game (2nd in the NHL) with good goalies on both sides; Last Word On Sports expects a goaltending game and predicts Montreal 3-2; Dimers' model leans under 6. Starting goalies were not confirmed when these were written.

sources.name: Last Word On Sports / Lori Bennett (Under 6.5)

ladder.label: Colorado Buffaloes +10.5
ladder.why: Covers, VSiN and BetMGM's model all take Colorado with the points, and the line has already moved from Houston -10.5 toward -9. Covers notes Houston is 108th in yards per play allowed and 1-5 against the spread as a favourite; VSiN points to three straight one-score Houston games. Even College Football News' Houston pick projects a 10-point win (31-21), inside this line.

ladder.label: Under 49.5
ladder.why: Covers takes Under 48.5: rain is expected, UCLA's defense leads the nation in EPA since Week 6, and both teams play slowly. UCLA lost two starting offensive linemen against Minnesota. Dimers' model projects UCLA 29-19, which is 48 total, under this line.

ladder.game: Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns @ UL Monroe Warhawks
ladder.label: Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns −10.5
ladder.why: Sports Betting Dime takes Louisiana -10.5: ULM is 0-4 at home scoring 20.1 a game, while Louisiana runs for 203.6 yards a game and is +6 in turnovers. College Football News predicts Louisiana 31-20 and BetMGM's model has Louisiana winning. Caution: Louisiana RB Anthony Reagan Jr. is out for the season, and 31-20 covers by only half a point.

ladder.label: Under 6.5
ladder.why: Dimers' model makes the under 54.3% against a 51-52¢ price. Last Word On Sports expects Linus Ullmark back in Ottawa's net and predicts a 3-2 Senators win, which is 5 goals. Neither goalie was confirmed when these were written.

sources.name: Last Word On Sports / Levi Pike (Senators 3-2)

ladder.label: Minnesota Wild −1.5
ladder.why: Sports Betting Dime's best bet is Minnesota -1.5: the Wild have won six straight road games and allowed 44 goals in 20 games, while Toronto is 1-6 in its last 7 with 70 goals against. Last Word On Sports predicts Wild 3-1 with Wallstedt (.925) in net and Gustavsson on IR. This is a 40¢ price, so it loses often even when Minnesota wins.

sources.name: Last Word On Sports / Braden Morrison (Wild 3-1)

ladder.label: Phoenix Suns
ladder.why: Four outlets back Phoenix, and top traders have about $2.6k on the Suns against $1.1k. Charlotte is without Brandon Miller, Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder, and Sports Mole notes the Hornets' net rating is -11.8 against Phoenix's -4.7. Dimers' model gives the Suns 69.4% and projects 110-104.
